responsibilities.name: model serializable UI nodes, widgets, interaction state, and theme data
currentOwners: crates/engine_ui/src/widget/node.rs::UiNode stores size, anchor, margin, and optional background
crates/engine_ui/src/widget/text.rs::Text stores text content and font settings
crates/engine_ui/src/interaction.rs::Interaction and FocusState store transient UI state
crates/engine_ui/src/theme.rs::UiTheme stores shared widget colors and font size
crates/engine_ui/src/ui_event.rs::UiEvent defines the public interaction event contract
dependencies: serde serialization for persisted UI data

responsibilities.name: compute anchored and flex layout positions from scene hierarchy
currentOwners: crates/engine_ui/src/layout/anchor.rs::Anchor and anchor_offset define nine anchor placements
crates/engine_ui/src/layout/flex.rs::FlexLayout and compute_flex_offsets define row and column spacing
dependencies: engine_scene Children and GlobalTransform2D hierarchy state
bevy_ecs query and deferred hierarchy semantics

responsibilities.name: translate mouse state into UI hit testing, focus, and events
currentOwners: crates/engine_ui/src/interaction.rs::ui_interaction_system drives per-entity hover, press, click, and focus transitions

responsibilities.name: queue, sort, cull, and render heterogeneous draw commands in one pass
currentOwners: crates/engine_ui/src/draw_command.rs::DrawCommand and DrawQueue define the immediate-mode render contract
crates/engine_ui/src/unified_render.rs::collect_*_draws converts shapes, text, meshes, and sprites into sorted commands
crates/engine_ui/src/unified_render.rs::draw_commands applies material state and emits the sorted renderer calls
crates/engine_ui/src/unified_render.rs::unified_render_system drains the queue after the render phase
dependencies: engine_render renderer, materials, camera culling, fonts, shapes, and sprites
engine_scene RenderLayer, SortOrder, visibility, and transforms
DrawQueue insertion order as the deterministic tie breaker
GlyphCache and renderer material state caching

responsibilities.name: render UI node backgrounds, text, and widget-specific primitives
expose the stable engine UI module and scheduling boundary
dependencies: crate-local module visibility and public API paths
axiom2d facade scheduling for PostRender unified rendering
engine crate dependency direction avoiding a UI-to-app cycle

findings.scope: The default scan covers 35 files with 55 errors and 244 warnings across 25 work units. Production contains 21 files with 12 errors and 86 warnings; tests contain 14 files with 43 errors and 158 warnings. The units and report artifacts are restricted to crates/engine_ui.
findings.architecture: The scoped report found zero placement, similarity, dependency, cycle, configurable-data, transitive-navigation, or extraction-error findings. Its 31 public-surface signals are fields on serialized ECS data and render-command records; cross-scope caller inspection found those records and systems consumed by axiom2d, card_game, demo, terrain_viewer, and engine_ui tests.
findings.reason: The 5-type draw_command.rs file is one queue/command contract, and the 474-line unified_render.rs file is one sorted pass whose collectors and draw path share DrawCommand variants, sort keys, culling, material state, and glyph-cache lifetimes. Splitting either would add private plumbing and compatibility paths without a demonstrated responsibility seam. The 2-type interaction.rs file is one input/focus contract; widget and layout responsibilities are already separated by file. The 601-line interaction test and other long test files contain explicit behavior fixtures, while duplicate blocks are repeated ECS setup rather than duplicated production ownership. Remaining findings are cosmetic or signature heuristics. No DELETE, DEDUPE, SPLIT, SIMPLIFY, SIGNATURES, or COSMETIC source change is justified by this evidence.
findings.behaviorEvidence: The focused baseline `cargo test -p engine_ui --locked` passed 94 integration tests with zero failures. No running-app UI smoke was used because this slice changes no rendering or input source; the existing module tests exercise headless layout, interaction, widget, text, and unified-render behavior.
findings.replayBlocker: Source-changing committed replay remains blocked solely by dod-guard#621: the bundled quality-guard gate requires the absent `.github/quality/quality-baseline.json` instead of this repository's `docs/QUALITY_BASELINE.ron`. No baseline or documentation file was created or edited.
